subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9feca06d004f50fce1a69d86b4c2bdf88e9fc6cb9f1ea36981487d35c95b8e4.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/709b21b75873e5772cefee13c8c102c1ad756bdd0464deaddc8c93e1265bf4d3.png] 

As 1 and 3 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 5 and 4 are opposite to each other.

Hence, '**5**' is the correct answer.
